excerpt_i18n.en: Waking up at 3 a.m. may be the most relatable anxiety scenario for contemporary professionals. We try to dredge up the flash of insight from a dinner two hours earlier, only to grasp a few vague words—supply chain? Downward market? Neuroscience research shows that without external reinforcement within 30 seconds of an idea's emergence, the loss rate of details can be as high as 70%. However, the real dilemma lies not in memory but in the act of recording itself. In business settings—toasting, shaking hands, driving, or networking at exhibitions—"pulling out a phone" is the ultimate social taboo and operational barrier. We generate countless ideas daily in casual coffee chats or brainstorming sessions, only to watch them die on the way to "operational tools." The current AI Agent market presents an interesting paradox: the more powerful the technology, the higher the barrier to use. Conversational agents require you to stay by the screen; wearable devices either listen indiscriminately (a privacy nightmare) or have complex activation processes (an operational burden). Users possess the most powerful AI yet miss opportunities at the very moments they need it most, simply because of the effort to "activate it." "Workplace efficiency has never been built on transcribing text. What we truly need is the ability to execute and bring ideas to life the moment they are spoken." This is the origin of Gyges Labs' creation of the Vocci Ring—the world's first AI note-taking ring, offering the shortest path to AI Agent interaction.
excerpt_i18n.es: Despertarse sobresaltado a las tres de la madrugada podría ser la escena de ansiedad más resonante para los profesionales contemporáneos. Intentamos rescatar en nuestra mente ese destello de inspiración que surgió hace dos horas durante la cena, pero solo logramos atrapar unas cuantas palabras difusas: ¿cadena de suministro? ¿mercado de bajos ingresos? La investigación en neurociencia muestra que, si no se consolida externamente en los primeros 30 segundos después de que surge una idea, la tasa de pérdida de detalles alcanza hasta el 70%. Sin embargo, la verdadera dificultad no radica en la memoria, sino en el acto mismo de registrar. Cuando te encuentras en un entorno empresarial —brindando, estrechando manos, conduciendo, intercambiando saludos en ferias— "sacar el teléfono" se convierte en el mayor tabú social y barrera operativa. A diario, generamos innumerables ideas en conversaciones de café y tormentas de ideas, pero las vemos desvanecerse ante nuestros ojos.

excerpt_i18n.en: As the AI industry shifts from competition in model capabilities to large-scale application deployment, systematic optimization around "Token inference efficiency" has become a core industry focus. With the explosive growth of applications such as AI agents and AI coding, Token consumption has surged by hundreds or even thousands of times, making 2026 the true "Year of Token Explosion." The industry's primary concern is transitioning from model parameter scale and usability to stable, low-cost, high-quality Token production capacity, stated Academician Zheng Weimin. However, domestic computing power utilization is mired in structural challenges. First, there is a severe imbalance in resource allocation, with Token generation overly reliant on GPUs, while expensive resources like high-end memory, cluster SSDs, and InfiniBand interconnects see less than 10% utilization, and overall machine utilization remains below 20%, leading to massive wastage in intelligent computing costs. Additionally, hardware-software coordination faces shortcomings: despite continuous hardware advancements, software optimization and distributed parallel stability are insufficient, wasting over 80% of theoretical computing power, with inefficient scheduling further incurring hidden losses exceeding 50%. Addressing these industry pain points, Leifeng Network learned that on March 27 during the 2026 Zhongguancun Forum, Qujing Technology launched its new-generation AI inference platform—the Qujing ATaaS High-Efficiency AI Token Production Service Platform (Approaching.AI Token as a Service)—offering a systematic solution to bridge the gap between computing power investment and Token output.
excerpt_i18n.es: A medida que la industria de la IA pasa de competir en capacidades de modelos a competir en aplicaciones a gran escala, la optimización sistemática en torno a la "eficiencia de inferencia de Tokens" se convierte en el núcleo del sector. Con el crecimiento explosivo de aplicaciones como agentes inteligentes y AI Coding, el consumo de Tokens ha aumentado cientos y miles de veces, haciendo de 2026 el auténtico "año de la explosión de Tokens". El enfoque principal de la industria de la IA está cambiando completamente desde la escala de parámetros del modelo y su usabilidad hacia la capacidad de producción de Tokens estable, de bajo costo y alta calidad, según afirmó el académico Zheng Weimin. Sin embargo, al mismo tiempo, la utilización de la capacidad computacional en el país se encuentra sumida en un dilema estructural. En primer lugar, la proporción de recursos está gravemente desequilibrada.

excerpt_i18n.en: In the AI era, enabling better collaboration between office software and intelligent assistants has become a new challenge. On March 30, the WeCom CLI open-source project was launched on the GitHub community, opening up seven core product capabilities including messaging, scheduling, documents, smart sheets, meetings, to-dos, and contacts, supporting calls from mainstream AI Agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, QClaw, etc.). Developers can leverage these capabilities to enable AI Agents to understand and utilize WeCom functionalities in a more natural way, quickly developing AI applications that better align with daily office scenarios. For businesses and users, using AI assistants like "Lobster" to call WeCom not only improves task execution accuracy but also significantly reduces token consumption. This open-source initiative prioritizes companies with 10 or fewer employees, offering multiple high-frequency capabilities: messaging supports retrieving one-on-one and group chat messages, as well as sending messages to specified users and groups; documents and smart sheets support creation, writing, and reading; scheduling supports creation, querying, updating, checking availability, and adding participants; meetings support booking, querying, canceling, and adding attendees; to-dos support creation, querying, adding participants, and updating status; contacts support retrieving members' user IDs, names, and remarks. For developers and AI Agents, the CLI is more than just an additional calling method compared to traditional interfaces.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la era de la IA, lograr una mejor colaboración entre el software de oficina y los asistentes inteligentes se ha convertido en un nuevo desafío. El 30 de marzo, el proyecto de código abierto CLI de WeChat Work se lanzó en la comunidad GitHub, abriendo siete capacidades principales del producto: mensajes, calendario, documentos, tablas inteligentes, reuniones, tareas pendientes y libreta de direcciones, compatibles con la invocación de los principales agentes de IA (como Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, QClaw, entre otros). Los desarrolladores pueden utilizar estas capacidades para permitir que los agentes de IA comprendan y utilicen las funciones de WeChat Work de manera más natural, desarrollando rápidamente aplicaciones de IA más cercanas a los escenarios cotidianos de oficina.
